dedupe_keys.name: contract farming in the mekong delta s rice supply chain agent based model of contract viability and processing capacity

description: This agent-based model examines whether contract rice farming can expand in Vietnam's Mekong Delta, seen from the contractor's side. It was published in the CoMSES library in 2019 by Hung Nguyen (version 1.1.0). The model addresses three obstacles to the large-scale paddy field programme: buyers failing to build trust with smallholder farmers, unattractive prices under contract schemes, and limited rice processing capacity. Financial incentives and trust drive whether each party decides to join a contract and whether it honours it. The code is available as a free download from CoMSES under the AFL-3.0 licence; the page lists IntelliJ as the development platform. Caveats: parameters reflect one region and scheme, and the page gives no validation. Coverage is the Mekong Delta, Vietnam. Simulation uses: understanding how processing capacity and contract terms limit rice supply to processors and markets. Related records: the food supply chain structure model for China (model-comses-food-supply-chain-structure-china) compares contract and spot market chains.
inputs: Offered prices, trust and processing capacity
